question: In right triangle \(ABC\), the hypotenuse has length \(AB=10\). How long is the median \(CD\) to the hypotenuse? (Enter only the number.)
solution: The median to the hypotenuse of a right triangle is half the length of the hypotenuse, so \(CD=10\div2=5\).
